description: Approving an estimate is NOT automatable and this tool always refuses. Housecall Pro gates approval behind a reCAPTCHA token only the real page can mint. Use this to get the explanation and the link to approve in a browser.

link.description: The Housecall Pro link your contractor sent you — paste it directly (pro.housecallpro.com/mobile_estimate/… or /mobile_invoice/…, or a client.housecallpro.com/estimates/… or /invoices/… URL), or the retrieval token from the end of it. Alternatively the label of a link configured in HOUSECALLPRO_LINKS. Omit only when exactly one link is configured.

name: housecallpro_approve_estimate
